title: Composed supervisory control: Clamped analog scaling with range status -> Temperature control with hysteresis

inputs.name: A_Raw
inputs.description: Subsystem A: Raw input nominally 0 through 4095

scan.initialization: fresh function-block instance for every test case

assumptions: Subsystem A: The function block is called exactly once per PLC scan.
Subsystem A: Inputs are sampled at scan start and outputs are checked at scan end.
Subsystem A: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem B: The function block is called exactly once per PLC scan.
Subsystem B: Inputs are sampled at scan start and outputs are checked at scan end.
Subsystem B: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem A executes before the supervisory latch and subsystem B within each scan.
Requirements inherited from subsystem B apply only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE.
When subsystem B is isolated, its externally visible outputs take their type-safe defaults.

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Raw below zero shall set A_UnderRange, clear A_OverRange, and clamp A_Engineering to 0.0.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Raw above 4095 shall set A_OverRange, clear A_UnderRange, and clamp A_Engineering to 10.0.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: In-range A_Raw shall clear both flags and scale linearly to 0.0 through 10.0.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_ConfigError shall be TRUE when B_LowThreshold is not less than B_HighThreshold.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: Disable or B_ConfigError shall turn B_Heater off.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: While enabled with valid thresholds, B_Temperature below or equal to B_LowThreshold shall turn B_Heater on.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> ((B_Enable AND !B_ConfigError AND B_Temperature<=B_LowThreshold) -> B_Heater))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Temperature above or equal to B_HighThreshold shall turn B_Heater off.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> ((B_Enable AND !B_ConfigError AND B_Temperature>=B_HighThreshold) -> !B_Heater))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: Between thresholds, B_Heater shall retain its previous state.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> ((B_Enable AND !B_ConfigError AND B_Temperature>B_LowThreshold AND B_Temperature<B_HighThreshold) -> B_Heater=prev(B_Heater)))

requirements.text: A TRUE A_UnderRange shall latch CrossReady unless CrossReset is TRUE in the same scan.
CrossReset shall have priority, clear CrossReady, and isolate every subsystem-B output to its type-safe default.
requirements.property: G(CrossReset -> (!CrossReady AND NOT B_Heater AND NOT B_ConfigError)) AND G((NOT (SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady)) -> (NOT B_Heater AND NOT B_ConfigError))

requirements.text: Once set, CrossReady shall remain TRUE after the subsystem-A signal falls, until a later CrossReset scan.
Subsystem B may execute only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE; CrossBlocked is TRUE exactly when SubsystemBEnable is requested without CrossReady.

provenance.origin: deterministic ordered composition of independently specified base behaviors
